parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied all global and Malayalam-specific rules. Replaced presenter Karthik with default Malayalam casting name Arun. Ensured the hook opens with native words ('India muzhuvan...'). Handled Malayalam grammar and vocabulary rules carefully: used 'samsaarikyunnilla' instead of 'speak cheyyunnilla', used person-sensitive 'tharoo' for 1st person 'give me', used 'kaliyaakyilla' for 'judge/mock', used 'athupole' for 'in the same way', avoided English-noun + Malayalam-case-ending hybrids (e.g., 'Malayalathil' instead of 'Malayalam-il', 'oru maasathil' instead of 'oru month-il'). Converted comparative multiplier '10 times cheaper' to '10 iratti sasta' and time units to local words ('manikyoorugal' for hours, 'maasathil' for month) while keeping digits as English numerals.

safety.summary: The ad is fully compliant with all brand-safety guardrails, utilizing approved social proof, comparative cost, and soft progress expectations.
